                             id  The meter id number.
                           name  Your name for the meter.
                          media  What does the meter measure?
                          meter  Meter driver.
                      timestamp  Timestamp when wmbusmeters received the telegram. Local time for hr/fields UTC for json.
                   timestamp_ut  Unix timestamp when wmbusmeters received the telegram.
                   timestamp_lt  Local time when wmbusmeters received the telegram.
                  timestamp_utc  UTC time when wmbusmeters received the telegram.
                         device  The wmbus device that received the telegram.
                       rssi_dbm  The rssi for the received telegram as reported by the device.
                 fabrication_no  Fabrication number.
                      on_time_h  How long the meter has been powered up.
             on_time_at_error_h  How long the meter has been in an error state while powered up.
                     meter_date  Meter date when telegram was sent.
                 meter_datetime  Meter date when telegram was sent.
               t2_temperature_c  Temperature of returned water.
               t1_temperature_c  Temperature of incoming water.
               current_power_kw  Instantaneous power consumed.
        current_volume_flow_m3h  Instantaneous water flow.
                total_volume_m3  Total volume of water used for heating.
        total_volume_cooling_m3  Total volume of water used for cooling.
               input1_volume_m3  Total volume of water used in input1.
               input2_volume_m3  Total volume of water used in input2.
               total_energy_kwh  The total heat energy consumption recorded by this meter.
       total_energy_cooling_kwh  The total cooling energy consumption recorded by this meter.
        total_energy_period_kwh  The total cooling energy consumption recorded by this meter.
total_energy_cooling_period_kwh  The total cooling energy consumption recorded by this meter.
                         status  Status and error flags.
